integrity: Exact lattice slicing and rational-arithmetic verification. The 10618-state enumerator uses proved exhaustive integer bounds. No independent external validation, certification, or publication is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The normalized-volume optimum is restricted to joins of four-dimensional positive-integer axis-aligned boxes with a unit lattice segment; other lattice polytopes and segment lengths are not classified. A finite exhaustive certificate proves only the minimizer under the mathematically derived volume cutoff; general polynomial and balancing identities have direct proofs. Older equivalent priority remains possible.
title: Sharp first Ehrhart-sign obstruction among unit-segment joins of four-dimensional lattice boxes
